title: Why Building Permit Data Is Your Best Defense Against Volatile Supply Chains
summary: Volatile supply chains are disrupting construction timelines and revenue. This article shows how suppliers and manufacturers can use building permit data to anticipate demand, reduce risk, and outmaneuver uncertainty in the construction industry.
body_text: How Real-Time Construction Activity Signals Can Help You Stay Ahead of Shocks, Shortages, and Shifting Demand In an era of frequent disruptions—from geopolitical tensions to extreme weather events—construction supply chains face unprecedented volatility. Material costs fluctuate, lead times grow uncertain, and planning becomes a moving target. Amid this instability, building permit data emerges as an indispensable asset, offering early visibility into upcoming construction demand and enabling data-informed decisions across procurement, logistics, and business development. This post explores how contractors, suppliers, developers, and manufacturers are using building permit data to mitigate risk, reduce waste, and seize opportunities ahead of competitors. Section 1: Understanding Today’s Supply Chain Risks in Construction A. Volatility is the New Normal The construction industry is grappling with continued supply chain disruptions sparked by: Global instability : Ongoing wars (e.g., Ukraine-Russia, Israel-Hamas) and strained trade relationships (e.g., U.S.-China) have led to tariffs, sanctions, and port delays. Labor shortages : The U.S. construction industry was short over 500,000 workers in 2023, contributing to delays across all project types. Material price swings : Prices for essential materials like concrete, drywall, and lumber remain unstable. In 2023, concrete rose 13% year-over-year. Gordian reported that framing lumber costs continue their relentless ascent, climbing 11.71% since Q2 of 2024. Climate-driven disruption : Extreme weather and natural disasters (floods, fires, hurricanes) damage infrastructure and increase demand unpredictably in affected regions. These variables create ripple effects that can derail even the most carefully planned projects—unless teams have access to early signals that allow for proactive planning. Section 2: Permit Data as an Early Warning System A. What Is Permit Data? Building permit data includes detailed information about upcoming construction activity—both residential and commercial. It provides insights into what is being built, where, and when , including: Project type (new build, remodel, addition) Size and scope Contractor and owner Location and timeline Valuation and materials used At BuildZoom, our permit intelligence spans millions of permits nationally , updated in near real-time and easily searchable through buildzoom.com/data . B. Why Permits Are Predictive Building permits precede actual construction by weeks to months , making them an early indicator of real market demand . By monitoring permits: Suppliers can anticipate order volumes. Manufacturers can optimize production. Contractors can assess material availability before bidding. Distributors can adjust regional inventory. Permits help businesses shift from reactive to proactive—an edge in today’s volatile environment. Section 3: Use Cases – How Permit Data Helps Supply Chain Planning A. Forecasting Material Demand by Region Example: A surge in roof replacement permits in Florida following a major hurricane gives roofing suppliers weeks of lead time to stock asphalt shingles, flashing, and underlayment materials before bottlenecks occur. Benefit : Inventory is deployed before prices spike, delivery times stretch, or backorders begin. B. Adjusting Distribution & Inventory Strategy Example: A national supplier sees a 20% year-over-year increase in multifamily building permits in Phoenix, AZ. They respond by shifting more HVAC units and appliances to their regional warehouse serving that market. Benefit : Reduced shipping delays, increased responsiveness to local demand, and lower storage costs elsewhere. C. Navigating Price Volatility with Project Targeting Example: A drywall supplier notices a drop in new construction permits in high-cost coastal metros but a rise in commercial tenant improvement projects in the Midwest. Benefit : Shift sales and marketing to recession-resistant project types, preserving margins during cost spikes. Section 4: Why BuildZoom’s Permit Data Leads the Market BuildZoom aggregates permit records from thousands of local municipalities and counties , standardizing them into a searchable, filterable database with unmatched coverage. Our data enables: Custom alerts for high-value projects Historical trend analysis to spot market shifts Filtering by contractor, material type, or valuation Exports and integrations for supply chain teams Unlike public sources, our platform offers clean, enriched, and commercial-grade permit intelligence that businesses can use immediately. Section 5: The Bottom-Line Value of Permit Data Challenge How Permit Data Helps Delays from price surges Get ahead of price hikes with demand forecasts Overstock in slow markets Reduce waste by aligning inventory with active regions Understock in high-demand zones Increase fulfillment with proactive warehouse planning Lost bids due to material costs Target projects with better margins or less lead time pressure Conclusion: Information Is Power in a Volatile Market In today’s unpredictable environment, staying ahead means knowing where construction is headed—not just where it’s been . Permit data is your early signal, your compass, and your advantage. title: How High-Energy Batteries are Enhancing Satellite Operations
summary: There are just shy of 12,000 satellites currently orbiting Earth as of June 2024, and that number is projected to rise to over 60,000 by 2030. All of them require batteries to power them when the sun is obscured from view or when they can’t harvest solar energy. This means there is huge demand to develop high-energy batteries to power ...
body_text: There are just shy of 12,000 satellites currently orbiting Earth as of June 2024, and that number is projected to rise to over 60,000 by 2030. All of them require batteries to power them when the sun is obscured from view or when they can’t harvest solar energy. This means there is huge demand to develop high-energy batteries to power this ever-growing satellite population. Here’s how battery technology is evolving in this field. The growing demand for efficient energy solutions in space technology Space is a harsh, challenging environment. High Energy-density technology is essential for mission success. Solar energy has long been a reliable power solution in space — missions have been using solar power for decades ! Today’s technology has evolved from its 1950s-era origins, with satellite batteries reaching new levels of energy density to store excess solar energy and ensure stability during periods of darkness. Understanding Satellite Energy Needs Satellite power and energy requirements vary based on size, purpose and orbit. The energy requirement for a satellite is determined largely on its mission . A CubeSat , for example, only needs a few watts, while a large, complex communication satellite could use energy in the range of tens of kilowatts. The more work a satellite has to do, the larger the payload it has to carry. In other words, the longer its mission, the more energy it’s going to need. Traditional energy sources used in satellites and their limitations Solar power and batteries have been the primary energy sources traditionally used in satellites. Fortunately, solar energy is abundant in space and reliable, providing consistent power in most orbits. However, it does have some drawbacks and limitations: First, solar cell energy efficiency degrades over time due to radiation damage and thermal cycling. Solar arrays are also susceptible to damage from space debris. The further a satellite is, the less effective solar power is, thus solar may not always be a reliable solution for missions that move deeper into space. During eclipse periods, solar energy is inaccessible. For complex satellites, large solar arrays are needed, which makes the satellite larger, heavier and more costly to launch. That’s where batteries come in. Conventional batteries are a vital energy storage system that complements solar power. They provide power during eclipse periods and other times when solar is not optimal. Batteries also play a pivotal role in a satellite’s initial deployment before solar panels can be activated. However, batteries have some limitations. They: Add weight. Have a limited lifespan. Degrade over time. Pose thermal management challenges in extreme space conditions. The Rise of High-Energy Batteries High Energy battery technologies can offer significant advantages over traditional power sources. Introduction to high-energy batteries and their technological advancements Battery selection in the aerospace industry is improving with technological advancements. Lithium-sulfur (Li-S) batteries are one example, offering a theoretical energy density of up to 500 Wh/kg , which is even higher than currently commercially available lithium-ion battery technologies. Sulfur is low-cost and abundant, offering great potential in reducing launch costs. NASA is testing these batteries in space suits and satellites alongside the Department of Defense. They will be sent to the International Space Station in 2025, with the goal of keeping satellites like Starlink and other low-orbit equipment in orbit for longer. While Li-S batteries are still in development, lithium-ion batteries have already demonstrated the ability to achieve high energy densities, as compared to conventional batteries. This allows for more payload capacity and reduced satellite mass. For example, implementing Li-ion technology on the W3A telecommunication satellite saved about 200 kg of satellite mass compared to previous battery technologies. As the above article from the European Space Agency states, lithium-ion batteries have “entirely supplanted” previous battery technology and are used in countless aerospace applications, including on the International Space Station. Comparing efficiency and capacity Lithium-ion batteries, especially those using silicon anode, vastly outperform conventional NiCd or NiH2 batteries. Amprius batteries , for example, offer commercial batteries up to 450 Wh/kg with recent third-party verification of 500 Wh/kg. That contrasts sharply with NiCd at 40-60 Wh/kg and NiH2 at 45-75 Wh/kg. The high energy density and power output of Amprius batteries make them particularly suitable for space applications where weight and volume are critical factors. Lithium-ion battery technology has a low self-discharge rate, which means that capacity is retained. They can handle deeper discharges without significant battery loss, so capacity is used more efficiently; and they offer better performance across a wider temperature range. Key features that make high-energy batteries ideal for space missions High Energy battery technology, particularly lithium-ion batteries – with the exception of LFP chemistry cells – is ideal for space missions for several reasons: They are high in energy density, which means more energy storage in a smaller, lighter package. High energy density also allows for increased payload. With high charge and discharge efficiency, lithium-ion batteries operate in space conditions without significant capacity loss. They can also be charged at any point in the discharge cycle without degradation — in other words, there is no memory effect . With a high-radiation tolerance, wide temperature range for operation and long cycle life, these batteries get the job done, even on long, complex missions. Applications in Satellite Operations Communication Satellites Communications satellites need uninterrupted data transmission for critical reasons. Continuous service impacts essential telecommunications, broadcasting and internet connectivity. A satellite with interrupted data transmission translates to service outages that impact millions of users worldwide. By nature, satellites of all kinds experience eclipse periods when they are not in direct sunlight, thus not receiving solar power. Batteries are the sole power source during these times, so high-quality, energy-dense batteries are absolutely vital to transmission. The uninterrupted power offered by batteries is also crucial to maintaining mission-critical satellite operations such as position control and data processing. Navigation Satellites High Energy battery technology allows for longer operational life and reduced maintenance for navigational satellites. This is important because launching satellites is expensive. Longer lifespans mean reduced launch costs, resulting in cost savings as multiple replacement launches become unnecessary. Fewer replacement launches also mean less space debris in the form of discarded satellites. Longer-lasting satellites offer continuous, reliable navigation services with minimal disruptions, which is critical for everything from communication to weather forecasting. Research Satellites Research satellites must collect data continuously whether they are receiving solar power or not. Batteries are critical for providing power to the satellite during eclipse periods to ensure the satellite continues to collect data. Better batteries also allow for a longer operational life allowing more time for data collection and scientific observations. With higher energy density, lithium-ion batteries and other advanced battery technologies enable more payload, or, in other words, potentially more scientific instruments to be present onboard a research satellite. Technological Innovations in High-Energy Batteries Recent tech advancements in battery chemistry and design Along with the silicon anode lithium-ion batteries and high-powered Li-S batteries mentioned above, lithium-polymer batteries are an exciting technological advancement. These are flexible and can be shaped to fit available spaces within a satellite with energy densities that are comparable to traditional lithium-ion cells. This makes them particularly valuable for small satellites, including nanotechnology like CubeSats. Innovations in lithium-ion batteries Amprius has developed lithium-ion batteries with silicon anodes that achieve extremely high energy densities. Technology like the SiMaxx cells boasts reduced weight essential for aerospace applications. Innovations in solid-state batteries Solid-state batteries are an exciting technology that use a solid electrolyte instead of liquid or polymer like lithium-ion batteries. These could offer energy density that is potentially double that of current lithium-ion technology, with enhanced safety as solid electrolytes are non-flammable. While solid-state batteries are a research work in progress, Harvard researchers recently developed a postage stamp-sized solid-state battery that retained 80% of its capacity after 6,000 charging cycles and could charge in 5-10 minutes. Future Trends in Battery Technology for Satellites Li-ion batteries are becoming the standard for satellite applications, driven by their higher energy density, lower weight and absence of memory effect compared to older technologies like NiCd and NiH2. We can expect the ongoing development of Li-ion batteries with improved performance for space conditions. Lithium-sulfur batteries are an emerging technology with the potential for even higher densities. While they are not perfect and face challenges like rapid capacity fade, research continues to delve into how to best overcome these shortcomings. Promising next-generation solid-state technology offers both higher energy density and better resistance to extreme conditions. These, along with lithium-polymer batteries, show potential for enabling new possibilities in Earth observation, communications and research. Challenges and Considerations Weight, durability and environmental factors in space Reducing weight is a top priority, as launch costs are thousands of dollars per kilogram . Even in a nanosatellite, one-third of the total weight of the spacecraft is taken by the power subsystem, with the batteries weighing one-third of that subsystem. Durability is critical in harsh space environments, with batteries required to withstand extreme temperature fluctuations, radiation, vacuum conditions and launch vibrations. This means battery technology has to go hand in hand with thermal management systems and other protective measures. Longevity is also key, as batteries need to last the entire mission duration. Technology with improved cycle life is integral. Safety measures/reliability in battery design and implementation After a satellite launch, its equipment cannot be replaced or repaired. The only option is to replace the entire satellite, an expensive prospect. Because of this, any battery technology on board must be safe and reliable throughout a satellite’s mission. Li-ion batteries need careful management to prevent overheating, overcharging or short circuits, and advanced battery management systems are needed to monitor cell voltage, temperature and charge state. The above-mentioned environmental factors—particularly intense radiation—can degrade battery materials over time, so there is increased demand for batteries that can support longer, more complex space missions in harsh environments. Future Potential of Batteries in Expanding Satellite Capabilities Advances in battery technologies, including lithium-sulfur, silicon anode Li-ion and solid-state batteries, promise higher energy densities than traditional lithium-ion batteries. This can lead to lighter satellites with more payload capacity or longer mission durations without increasing mass. Future battery designs also strive for extended lifespans, potentially exceeding 15 years. This is critical for satellites operating for long durations without maintenance or replacement, enhancing mission reliability and reducing costs. New battery technologies are also being developed to withstand extreme temperatures, radiation and vacuum conditions. For example, NanoTritium batteries offer a long life of 20 or more years, and durability against environmental challenges, potentially making them suitable for ongoing challenging satellite missions. Further research/investment in energy tech for space Space may be the final frontier, but we’ve barely scratched the surface, especially when it comes to research and investment in energy tech. Space-based solar power is one example. It collects sunlight continuously, which can be transmitted back to Earth as energy. Satellites themselves are being used to monitor greenhouse gas emissions and assess the potential for renewable energy on Earth. Collaborative efforts, investments in technology and a constant drive toward energy-dense, affordable, lightweight batteries will drive these innovations and others.

title: Canada : TotalEnergies signe un accord en vue d’exporter 2 Mtpa de GNL pendant 20 ans à partir du projet Ksi Lisims LNG
summary: TotalEnergies a signé avec Ksi Lisims LNG un accord pour l’achat pendant 20 ans de 2 Mt/an de GNL provenant de la future usine située à l’Ouest du Canada. TotalEnergies prend également une participation de 5 % dans la société Western LNG, le développeur, actionnaire et futur opérateur du projet Ksi Lisims LNG. Paris, 19 mai 2025 – […]
body_text: TotalEnergies a signé avec Ksi Lisims LNG un accord pour l’achat pendant 20 ans de 2 Mt/an de GNL provenant de la future usine située à l’Ouest du Canada. TotalEnergies prend également une participation de 5 % dans la société Western LNG, le développeur, actionnaire et futur opérateur du projet Ksi Lisims LNG. Paris, 19 mai 2025 – TotalEnergies a signé un accord (SPA) avec Ksi Lisims LNG pour l'achat, pendant 20 ans, de 2 Mt/an de GNL provenant de la future usine de liquéfaction, sous réserve de la décision finale d'investissement du projet. En parallèle, TotalEnergies acquiert une participation de 5% dans Western LNG, le développeur, actionnaire et futur opérateur du projet Ksi Lisims LNG. Cette acquisition accorde à TotalEnergies l'option d'augmenter sa participation dans Western LNG et/ou de prendre une participation directe dans l'usine jusqu’à environ 10 % lorsque la décision finale d'investissement sera prise. Le projet Ksi Lisims LNG, une usine de gaz naturel liquéfié (GNL) d'une capacité de 12 millions de tonnes par an (Mt/an), est situé sur la côte pacifique du Canada (Colombie-Britannique), lui donnant un accès privilégié vers l'Asie, le plus grand marché du GNL. Entièrement électrifié et alimenté avec de l’hydroélectricité, Ksi Lisims LNG sera l'un des projets de GNL les moins émetteurs de CO2 au monde. « Cet achat de GNL de la future usine Ksi Lisims LNG nous permettra de diversifier notre portefeuille de GNL en Amérique du Nord et de bénéficier d’un approvisionnement en GNL compétitif à l'ouest du Canada pour mieux servir nos clients asiatiques, avec lesquels nous développons un portefeuille important de contrats d'approvisionnement à long terme », a déclaré Stéphane Michel, Directeur général Gas, Renewables & Power de TotalEnergies . « Dans le cadre de notre stratégie intégrée, nous nous réjouissons également de nous associer à Western LNG pour soutenir le développement de ce projet d'usine de liquéfaction à très faibles émissions de CO2 ». ***

title: Le persone chiedono anche: cos'è e come ottimizzarlo
summary: People Also Ask (PAA) è una funzione di ricerca di Google che mostra domande correlate alla query di ricerca dell'utente
body_text: Abbiamo tradotto questo articolo dall'inglese. Clicca qui per leggere l'articolo originale. Se noti qualche problema con i contenuti, non esitare a contattarci all'indirizzo report-osteam@semrush.com . Cosa chiedono anche le persone? People Also Ask (PAA) è una funzione di ricerca di Google che mostra domande correlate alla query di ricerca iniziale dell'utente. E spesso compare in cima alle pagine dei risultati dei motori di ricerca (SERP). Questa funzionalità aiuta gli utenti a trovare maggiori informazioni sul loro argomento senza dover effettuare ricerche aggiuntive. Cliccando su una domanda PAA, questa viene aperta e viene visualizzata una breve risposta. Per ogni risposta presente in People Also Ask, Google ha ricavato le informazioni da una pagina web specifica che puoi visitare per maggiori informazioni. A volte potresti vedere un semplice paragrafo. Ma la risposta potrebbe anche includere un elenco puntato, una tabella, un'immagine o persino un video. Perché la domanda "Le persone chiedono" di Google è importante? People Also Ask è un tipo di funzionalità SERP (un risultato unico che si distingue dagli elenchi standard) che aiuta gli utenti ad approfondire gli argomenti senza dover perfezionare le loro query di ricerca. In questo modo gli utenti possono trovare ciò di cui hanno bisogno in modo più efficiente. Ciò rappresenta un'opportunità per i proprietari di siti web e per gli esperti SEO. Perché se il tuo sito web compare sia nei risultati di ricerca standard sia nei box PAA, puoi ottenere maggiore visibilità. Il che può tradursi in maggiori entrate. Ciò è particolarmente vero se si considera che le caselle "Le persone chiedono anche" compaiono nel 51,85% di tutte le ricerche, secondo i dati di Semrush Sensor di agosto 2024. Le caselle PAA sono utili anche per trovare nuove parole chiave da utilizzare nei tuoi contenuti. Per aiutarti ad attrarre più visitatori che cercano informazioni specifiche. Come trovare persone che fanno anche domande Esistono diversi metodi per scoprire le domande PAA relative agli argomenti che hai trattato o che intendi trattare: Utilizza lo strumento Keyword Magic di Semrush Lo strumento Keyword Magic Tool di Semrush è una risorsa potente per scoprire domande PAA relative a termini per i quali non hai ancora contenuti. Per iniziare, inserisci una parola chiave generica correlata al tuo marchio insieme al tuo nome di dominio. E clicca su " Cerca ". Lo strumento genererà un elenco di parole chiave correlate. E visualizza per ciascuna un punteggio di difficoltà personale delle parole chiave (PKD%), che indica quanto sarà difficile per il tuo dominio specifico posizionarsi per quei termini. Fai clic sul menu a discesa " Filtri avanzati ", seleziona il menu a discesa " Qualsiasi " in "Funzionalità SERP" e seleziona la casella accanto a "Le persone chiedono anche". Quindi, fai clic su " Applica ". Ora vedrai solo i termini che attivano le caselle PAA. Scegli una parola chiave primaria (la parola chiave principale su cui si concentrerà il tuo contenuto) considerando quante ricerche mensili riceve e quanto è probabile che tu venga posizionato per essa. Per vedere le domande poste anche da altre persone per la parola chiave selezionata, clicca sull'icona a sinistra della colonna "SF". Nell'anteprima SERP visualizzata, analizza la sezione Le persone chiedono anche per vedere le domande che compaiono. Puoi quindi incorporare queste domande e le relative risposte nei tuoi contenuti. Più avanti in questo articolo spiegheremo come fare. Utilizza lo strumento di ricerca organica di Semrush Lo strumento Ricerca organica ti consente di visualizzare le parole chiave per cui sei già posizionato nei risultati di ricerca, ma non nelle sezioni PAA. E queste sono opportunità preziose per ampliare la tua visibilità. Apri lo strumento, inserisci il tuo nome di dominio e clicca su " Cerca ". Quindi, vai alla scheda “ Posizioni ”. Fai clic sul menu a discesa "Funzionalità SERP", scegli " Il dominio non è classificato " e seleziona " Le persone chiedono anche ". In questo modo verranno visualizzate le parole chiave in cui sei posizionato nei risultati di ricerca standard, ma non nelle caselle PAA. Per ciascuna di queste parole chiave, controlla le domande PAA correnti che compaiono nei risultati di ricerca. Verifica se i tuoi contenuti includono già queste domande e rispondono a esse. In caso contrario, dovrai aggiornare i tuoi contenuti. Utilizza la ricerca Google Un altro metodo efficace per scoprire le domande PAA è semplicemente utilizzare la Ricerca Google. Basta inserire l'argomento nella barra di ricerca e premere Cerca. Nella pagina dei risultati, cerca la casella Le persone chiedono anche con alcune domande. Cliccando su una di queste domande, verranno visualizzate altre domande correlate. Puoi continuare a cliccare sulle domande per visualizzare ancora più query correlate. Usa AlsoAsked AlsoAsked è uno strumento per parole chiave progettato appositamente per trovare domande di People Also Ask. Inserisci l'argomento nella barra di ricerca e clicca su " Cerca ". Lo strumento genererà una mappa visiva delle domande correlate che le persone pongono sul tuo argomento. Ogni nodo sulla mappa rappresenta una domanda e puoi cliccare su qualsiasi nodo per espanderlo ulteriormente. Per rivelare ulteriori domande associate alla query originale. Come ottimizzare i tuoi contenuti per le caselle "Le persone chiedono anche" Ora che abbiamo visto come trovare le domande di People Also Ask, vediamo come utilizzare queste domande in modo efficace nei tuoi contenuti. Così puoi aumentare la tua visibilità nei risultati di ricerca. 1. Includi le domande PAA come titoli e sottotitoli I titoli e i sottotitoli (H1, H2, H3, ecc.) comunicano a Google quali argomenti trattano i tuoi contenuti. Quando inserisci le domande PAA come sottotitoli, fornisci a Google un chiaro segnale che il tuo contenuto è pertinente a quelle query. Ciò aumenta le possibilità che i tuoi contenuti vengano pubblicati nelle caselle PAA. 2. Rispondi direttamente alle domande Cerca di rispondere alle domande nel modo più diretto possibile, in modo che Google possa più facilmente abbinare il tuo contenuto alla domanda. E aumenta la probabilità che il tuo contenuto venga selezionato come risposta. Ad esempio, l'American Osteopathic Association risponde alla domanda della PAA "Quali sono i benefici dello yoga?" con un elenco chiaro di benefici. 3. Allinearsi al formato esistente Le risposte PAA possono apparire in vari formati, come paragrafi, elenchi puntati ed elenchi numerati. Quindi è una buona idea analizzare il formato delle risposte attuali. Ad esempio, questa risposta è presentata come un breve paragrafo. Ciò significa che dovresti cercare di replicare quello stile nei tuoi contenuti. Per aumentare le tue possibilità di apparire nel box PAA. 4. Ottimizza le tue immagini Talvolta le risposte PAA includono immagini. E ottimizzando le tue immagini aumenterai le probabilità che vengano pubblicate. Ecco due buone pratiche per ottimizzare le immagini: Usa un testo alternativo descrittivo. Assicurati che ogni immagine abbia un testo alternativo che descriva accuratamente di cosa tratta l'immagine. Ciò aiuta Google a comprendere il contesto dell'immagine. Scegli nomi di file informativi. Utilizzare nomi di file descrittivi come "benefits-of-yoga.jpg" (piuttosto che nomi generici come "IMG1234.jpg") per indicare il contenuto dell'immagine. Aumenta la tua visibilità tramite le caselle PAA Apparire nelle sezioni "Le persone chiedono anche" ti aiuta a raggiungere più persone di quante ne raggiungeresti altrimenti. Ciò si traduce in più traffico e potenzialmente più entrate. Il primo passo è stabilire quali domande PAA includere nel contenuto. Ciò che puoi fare con lo Keyword Magic Tool . Provalo oggi stesso.

title: Best Startup Recruiting Agencies: 2025 Rankings
summary: Our July 2026 ranking of the best recruiting agencies for startups. Compare top options for early-stage hiring, executive search, and fractional support.
body_text: For tech startup founders, finding the right startup recruiting agency can make or break early team-building efforts. That’s why we’ve compiled a 2025 ranking of the best recruiting firms and platforms to help you hire great talent. Our #1 pick is Dover , an all-in-one solution for startup recruiting, followed by other popular options like Paraform and Riviera Partners, so you can compare what each offers. Dover – Best Overall Recruiting Solution for Startups (Rank #1) Dover takes the top spot as the best recruiting solution for startups in 2025. We are not saying this as we are biased, but the features we offer to startups say it all. Unlike a traditional agency, Dover combines a free hiring platform with on-demand recruiting services . In one package, you get free AI-powered tools, multi-channel sourcing, and a marketplace of fractional recruiters who step in or out based on your hiring needs. This blend of software and service, built for startups, makes Dover a one-stop shop for companies looking to scale their team. What key features and benefits make Dover #1 Free ATS and Career Pages: Dover offers a full-featured, free Applicant Tracking System . You can track applicants, organize your pipeline, and get an AI-generated careers page and job descriptions to kickstart your hiring process. AI Candidate Scoring: Dover’s platform uses AI-powered resume scoring to automatically shortlist the most promising candidates for you. This means you spend time on the applicants who matter most, rather than sifting endlessly. Integrated Sourcing Tools: Need to reach out to talent? Dover includes a sourcing extension that helps you find and connect with candidates in seconds. It can send personalized outreach emails as well. One-Click Job Board Posting: Dover allows you to post a job opening to 50+ job boards with a single click. This saves you the hassle of manually posting on sites like Indeed, LinkedIn, AngelList, etc. Employee Referrals System: Early hires often come through personal networks. Dover makes it easy to tap into it via a built-in employee referrals system . Team members can submit referrals, and you can track those candidates through the same pipeline. Agency Management Portal: If you’re working with external recruiting agencies besides Dover, the platform offers an Agency Portal to coordinate them. It gives you full visibility into candidates submitted by agencies, their status, and the costs. Analytics and Hiring Insights: Dover provides analytics to help you improve your hiring process. You can see metrics like cost-per-hire and recruiter fill rates before engaging a recruiter, and track how your job posts are performing. Marketplace of Fractional Recruiters: When you need extra help, you can tap into Dover’s marketplace of vetted recruiters . Dover has a network of seasoned recruiters who can work as an extension of your team on a flexible, part-time basis . Ease of Use & Speed: Startup founders praise how easy it is to start with Dover. You can sign up, invite your team, and have job listings live within minutes. The interface is user-friendly, and many tedious tasks are automated behind the scenes. In short, Dover is built to make hiring as effortless as possible for a small team . Over 600 startups use Dover’s platform and services, including companies backed by top VCs. Considerations: Startup-friendly pricing Cost is often a deciding factor for startups, and Dover shines here as well. The core platform (ATS and tools) is free, and the fractional recruiter service is pay-as-you-go . Most companies using Dover’s recruiters spend around $80/hour, which averages out to about $4k–$7k per hire on the platform . Compare that to traditional recruiting agencies that often charge 15–30% of a hire’s salary (easily $15k-$30k+ for an engineer or designer). In short, Dover can save startups a lot of money on recruiting. Dover even shows the historical cost-per-hire for each recruiter in its marketplace, so you know what to expect before you start When to choose Dover If you’re a seed or Series A startup looking for an all-in-one recruiting solution that is easy, cost-effective, and scalable, Dover is a perfect choice. It’s especially useful if you don’t have any full-time recruiting staff or want to avoid paying hefty agency retainers. Dover lets you centralize everything, from job postings, candidate tracking to external recruiters. Given its extensive feature set and strong track record, Dover earns our #1 ranking for startup recruiting in 2025. Paraform – On-Demand Recruiter Marketplace (Rank #2) Coming in at #2 is Paraform , a marketplace that connects startups with independent recruiters on demand. Startups simply post the roles they need to fill, and a pool of vetted freelance recruiters can jump in to help. This model taps into the wave of experienced recruiters who left big tech companies during the recent layoff cycles and are now freelancing, so the talent network is quite deep. To date, 200+ startups have used Paraform to fill roles ranging from software engineers to sales reps. How it works: Paraform’s platform lets you list your job openings and the kind of recruiters you are looking for. Once you start working with a recruiter through the platform, Paraform provides tools for communication and managing the process, but you’ll still handle interviewing and final hiring decisions internally . Key benefits Speed: Recruiters are motivated to perform well as they get paid per hire or interview milestone. And as a result, you quickly get multiple independent recruiters sourcing candidates for you. Affordable: Paraform charges startups a subscription/listing fee to post jobs, plus a success fee when you make a hire. This makes sure recruiters only get paid when they get results. Considerations As Paraform is relatively new (founded in 2023), it doesn’t come with decades of reputation. The pool of recruiters is large, but quality can vary. Paraform does vet them, but you might need to review recruiter profiles and track their performance. In contrast, Dover actually provides performance data upfront. Also, Paraform is primarily a marketplace , not a full software suite. You won’t get a built-in ATS or AI tools as you do with Dover. This means you’ll likely need your own system to manage the candidates the recruiters send your way. When to choose Paraform Paraform is a strong choice if you need recruiting help fast and want to cast a wide net of recruiters without committing to a single agency. Very early-stage companies (say, under 20 people) have succeeded using Paraform for their first critical hires. Companies often use Paraform to fill high-demand roles like engineering or sales roles. Overall, Paraform has carved out a niche as a flexible, cost-effective alternative to traditional agencies , making it our #2 recommendation. Riviera Partners – Top Executive Search for Tech (Rank #3) Ranking #3 is Riviera Partners , a premier executive search firm specializing in tech talent , particularly leadership roles in engineering, product, and design. If you need to hire a CTO, VP of Engineering, Head of Product , or similar high-level position, Riviera is often the go-to choice. They’ve been around for about two decades and have a strong track record of placing top executives in venture-backed startups and larger tech companies. Key benefits Deep executive network: Their team focuses solely on tech and product leadership searches. Riviera acts as an extension of your company’s leadership team. They will refine the role requirements with you, headhunt passive candidates, and thoroughly vet each candidate. Data-driven approach . Their internal database and machine learning models help them find candidates with the right domain knowledge and success in similar roles. Reputation and reach: Trusted by top VCs and CEOs, Riviera is often investor-recommended. Their presence in major hubs like Silicon Valley, NYC, and London expands your talent access. Considerations This is a full-service retained executive search firm, with a focus on hiring for senior roles, which means it’s one of the pricier options. Typically, you’ll pay a retainer upfront and a fee that’s often 25-30% of the hired candidate’s first-year salary, around $50K-$60K for a $200K hire. Another thing to note is the timeline; executive searches can take at least 3-6 months, not suitable for quick hires. Riviera will present a slate of candidates and help schedule multiple rounds of interviews. When to choose Riviera Partners If your startup is at the point where you need a key executive and you cannot afford a mis-hire , Riviera is a top choice. Seed-stage startups likely won’t use Riviera, but by Series A or B, especially with investor funding, you might. In short, Riviera Partners is the best recruiting agency for technical executive hires. Their expertise and network in that arena are beyond compare, which earns them our #3 ranking. Hunt Club – Referral-Driven Recruiting Service (Rank #4) At #4, we have Hunt Club , popular for its referral-driven approach to recruiting . Hunt Club has a network of 20,000+ industry experts who refer candidates from their own circles. How Hunt Club works: Instead of relying solely on LinkedIn or a recruiter’s contacts, Hunt Club taps into a network of industry experts who refer top candidates, often passive ones. They match your job description with relevant experts, who then provide warm referrals. This model gives them access to 8M+ potential candidates and typically yields higher-quality leads. Their proprietary tech streamlines outreach and referral tracking, while their recruiters guide you through interviews and hiring like a traditional search firm. Considerations Use cases: Hunt Club works on a variety of roles, both executive and non-executive . One thing to note is that Hunt Club isn’t exclusively for startups; they have clients ranging from early-stage startups to more veteran companies. That breadth can be good or bad depending on your perspective. Cost model: Hunt Club charges like a traditional recruiting firm, likely as a percentage of salary or a flat fee per hire. They might also have some upfront or project fees, given the amount of work put in (varies with case). One positive is that by using referrals, they often find candidates who stick around, which can save money in the long run. When to choose Hunt Club Hunt Club is a great option if you want to hire through referrals and have access to passive candidates. For roles where cultural fit or specific industry experience is a priority, a referral-based approach can yield ideal candidates. In summary, Hunt Club offers a unique blend of high-tech and high-touch recruiting , and it ranks #4 on our list as an excellent choice for startups that want a referral-powered talent pipeline. Korn Ferry – Global Executive Search & Advisory (Rank #5) Rounding out our list at #5 is Korn Ferry , a global executive search firm. I n fact, it’s one of the largest and most reputable firms, with offices around the world. If your startup needs to bring in a heavy-hitter (like a seasoned CEO or another C-suite executive) or search globally, Korn Ferry could be a contender. Key benefits Scale and reach: Korn Ferry has an army of consultants and researchers, and a database built over decades, currently over 5 billion data points on candidates across industries. For a startup founder, it means you’re getting a thorough, methodical search with global reach. Specialized Teams: They have specialized teams for different functions and industries, so a tech startup would likely work with Korn Ferry’s technology practice experts. These recruiters understand the profile you need and can tap into a worldwide network of contacts. Assessment tools: They have proprietary methods to assess a candidate’s resume, leadership style, competencies, and culture fit. After rigorously vetting candidates, they often produce detailed candidate reports to help your team understand each person’s strengths and potential gaps. A startup probably wouldn’t use these initially, but it’s worth noting that if you engage Korn Ferry, you’re dealing with a firm that can advise on multiple talent-related fronts. Considerations Korn Ferry’s services come with a premium price tag . They typically operate on a retained basis for executive searches, which involves an upfront fee and total costs that can also land in approximately 25-30% of the salary range. For early-stage startups, this is often expensive unless you’ve raised a huge round earmarked to hire a key executive. Also, Korn Ferry is a big firm, some startups feel that they may not get the same personal touch or urgency that a boutique recruiter might provide. When to choose Korn Ferry Consider Korn Ferry when your hiring need is extremely critical, high-profile, or global . For example, if your Series C startup is expanding to Europe and you need a General Manager for EMEA operations, their global presence can help you find someone with the exact experience. It’s often not the first stop for a young startup, but as you grow, it’s a firm that can literally find anyone, anywhere. We’ve placed Korn Ferry at #5 because, while not every startup will use them, their capabilities in executive recruiting are world-class, and for the right situation, they can deliver transformative hires. Conclusion: Picking the Right Recruiting Partner Choosing a recruiting agency or solution as a startup founder comes down to aligning with your hiring needs, budget, and company stage . All the options in our “best of 2025” list have their strengths: Service Best For What You Get Dover Early-stage startups All-in-one hiring platform + on-demand fractional recruiters; affordable and flexible Paraform Fast, flexible hiring for start-ups Marketplace of recruiters; quick fills, but more founder involvement for later stages. Riviera / Korn Ferry Executive-level hires (Series A-B, if funded) Premium agencies with deep networks; ideal for VP/C-suite searches Hunt Club Start-ups that need mid-to-senior-level, passive candidates Referral-driven recruiting; access to vetted, hard-to-reach talent In practice, many startups use a combination of these strategies over time. The key is to be aware of what each offers, what you need, and where each shines to help you reach your goals, on budget. Pro Tip: Always clarify the terms before engaging any recruiting service. Some work on contingency (you pay only if you hire a candidate they find), while others are retained (you pay a fee regardless of the outcome). Most startups prefer contingency to reduce risk, but make sure you set expectations on fees, timeline, and what happens if a hire doesn’t work out (many offer a replacement guarantee in the first 3-6 months). In the end, the best recruiting agency for your startup is the one that understands your needs and can find people who align with your mission and culture. If you’re looking for a versatile, startup-tailored solution, you can’t go wrong starting with our #1 pick, Dover for startup recruiting . Happy hiring in 2025!

title: Apache’s U.K. Offshore Workforce Funds Specialist Equipment for New Neonatal Unit
summary: Offshore workforce supports Aberdeen neonatal unit... The post Apache’s U.K. Offshore Workforce Funds Specialist Equipment for New Neonatal Unit appeared first on APA Corporation .
body_text: Offshore workforce supports Aberdeen neonatal unit… A charitable donation pledged by the offshore workforce on our North Sea platforms has helped to buy a specialized endoscope for the neonatal unit at Aberdeen’s Baird Family Hospital. Our U.K. crane and lifting technical authority, Will Talbot, nominated The Archie Foundation following the support he and his wife, Michelle, received after the early arrival of their son, Callum, now aged seven. “Callum was a miracle baby for us after six years of IVF and a late miscarriage,” said Will. “He was born at 29 weeks and weighed only 3 pounds, but we were just so happy he was finally here.” Callum spent seven weeks in Aberdeen’s neonatal unit, and the parents’ facilities and free accommodation provided by The Archie Foundation was a huge support for Will and Michelle. “He was in an incubator in high dependency before being moved to special care once he got stronger. He received amazing care from the staff at the neonatal unit and we really appreciated the support we received, including a night in the parents’ accommodation,” said Will. “When I saw the opportunity to nominate a charity to benefit from the offshore bond committee donation, I wanted to nominate the Archie Foundation, and we are so grateful it was chosen by my offshore colleagues.” The donation marked the first major gift to Archie in the charity’s 25th anniversary year, and coincidentally, Callum, who inspired the donation, shares the same birthday as the charity. The funding will pay for a full Storz endoscope kit, which will allow medical staff to monitor and manage babies’ airways and provide the best possible outcome for little ones with breathing difficulties. Kelly M. Anderson, head of fundraising at The Archie Foundation, said the funding from Apache would make an incredible difference to babies and their families. “This is a wonderful birthday gift for both Archie and Callum, which is going to make such an impact for babies and families within the neonatal unit. We are extremely grateful to the team at Apache Corporation for choosing Archie to benefit from the proceeds raised by the offshore workforce on Apache’s North Sea platforms,” she said. “Archie works closely with NHS Grampian to ensure that the Baird Family Hospital will provide world class care and treatment at every point of contact for the babies and families of Aberdeen and north Scotland. title: Trajectory Viewer for Cua
summary: Explore, debug, and analyze your agent's actions with the cua Trajectory Viewer tool. Step through every observation and action in your browser!
body_text: Published on May 13, 2025 by Dillon DuPont Don’t forget to check out Part 1: Building your own Computer-Use Operator and Part 2: Using the Agent framework for setting up your Cua environment and basic tips and tricks! Introduction Okay, so you’ve gotten your environment up and also tested a few agent runs. You’ll likely have encountered cases where your agent was successful at doing some tasks but also places where it got stuck or outright failed. Now what? If you’ve ever wondered exactly what your computer agent is doing and why it sometimes doesn’t do what you expected, then the Trajectory Viewer for Cua is here to help! Whether you’re a seasoned developer or someone who just wants to dive in and see results, this tool makes it easy to explore every step your agent takes on your screen. Plus, if you want to start thinking about generating data to train your own agentic model (we’ll cover training in an upcoming blog, so look forward to it), then our Trajectory Viewer might be for you. So, what’s a “trajectory”? Think of a trajectory as a detailed video recording of your agent’s journey: Observations : What did the agent see (the exact screen content) at each point in time? Actions : What clicks, keystrokes, or commands did it perform in response? Decisions : Which options did it choose, and why? Especially for longer and more complex tasks, your agent will make multiple steps, take multiple actions, and make multiple observations. By examining this record, you can pinpoint where things go right, and more importantly, where they go wrong. So, what’s Cua’s Trajectory Viewer and why use it? The Trajectory Player for Cua is a GUI tool that helps you explore saved trajectories generated from your Cua computer agent runs. This tool provides a powerful way to: Debug your agents : See exactly what your agent saw to reproduce bugs Analyze failure cases : Identify the moment when your agent went off-script Collect training data : Export your trajectories for your own processing, training, and more! The viewer allows you to see exactly what your agent observed and how it interacted with the computer all through your browser. Opening Trajectory Viewer in 3 Simple Steps Visit : Open your browser and go to https://cua.ai/trajectory-viewer . Upload : Drag and drop a trajectories folder or click Select Folder. Explore : View your agent’s trajectories! All data stays in your browser unless you give permission otherwise. Recording a Trajectory Using the ComputerAgent API Trajectories are saved by default when using the ComputerAgent API: python agent.run("book a flight for me") You can explicitly control trajectory saving with the save_trajectory parameter: python from cua import ComputerAgent agent = ComputerAgent(save_trajectory=True) agent.run("search for hotels in Boston") Each trajectory folder is saved in a trajectories directory with a timestamp format, for example: trajectories/20250501_222749 Exploring and Analyzing Trajectories Our Trajectory Viewer is designed to allow for thorough analysis and debugging in a friendly way. Once loaded, the viewer presents: Timeline Slider : Jump to any step in the session Screen Preview : See exactly what the agent saw Action Details : Review clicks, keypresses, and API calls Logs & Metadata : Inspect debug logs or performance stats Use these features to: Step through each action and observation; understand your agent’s decision-making Understand why and where your agent failed Collect insights for improving your instructions, prompts, tasks, agent, etc. The trajectory viewer provides a visual interface for stepping through each action your agent took, making it easy to see what your agent “sees”. Getting Started Ready to see your agent in action? Head over to the Trajectory Viewer and load up your first session. Debug smarter, train faster, and stay in control (all within your browser). Happy tinkering and Cua on! Have questions or want to share feedback? Join our community on Discord or open an issue on GitHub.

title: Sol-Gel Reports First Quarter 2025 Results
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Sol-Gel Technologies Ltd's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_text: Release Details Sol-Gel Reports First Quarter 2025 Results May 23, 2025 PDF Version NESS ZIONA, Israel, May 23, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sol-Gel Technologies, Ltd . (NASDAQ: SLGL), a clinical-stage dermatology company, today announced financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2025. Financial Results for the First Quarter Year Ended March 31 st , 2025 Total revenue in the first quarter was $1 million compared to $0.5 million revenues for the same period in 2024. Research and development expenses were $8.8 million compared to $5.3 million in the same period in 2024. The increase of $3.5 million was primarily attributed to an increase of $3.6 million due to expenses associated with supplier-led manufacturing development to support future commercialization of SGT-610, an increase of $0.5 million related to the commercialization of EPSOLAY and TWYNEO in territories outside of the U.S., offset by a decrease of $0.5 million in clinical trial expenses related to SGT-610. General and administrative expenses were $1.3 million compared to $1.8 million for the same period in 2024. The decrease of $0.5 million was mainly attributed to a decrease in payroll and stock-based compensation expenses due to cost measures being taken in 2024. Sol-Gel reported a net loss of $8.8 million for the first quarter of 2025 and of $3.2 basic and diluted loss per share, compared to a net loss of $6.3 million and a loss of $2.3 per basic and diluted share for the same period in 2024. As of March 31, 2025, Sol-Gel had $16.9 million in cash, cash equivalents, and deposits and no marketable securities for a total balance of $16.9 million. The Company expects its cash resources to fund cash requirements into the first quarter of 2027. About Sol-Gel Technologies Sol-Gel Technologies, Ltd. is a dermatology company focused on identifying, developing and commercializing or partnering drug products for the treatment of skin diseases. Sol-Gel developed TWYNEO which is approved by the FDA for the treatment of acne vulgaris in adults and pediatric patients nine years of age and older; and EPSOLAY, which is approved by the FDA for the treatment of inflammatory lesions of rosacea in adults. The Company’s pipeline includes Orphan Drug candidate, SGT-610 under investigation for the prevention of new basal cell carcinomas in Gorlin syndrome patients, and also includes topical drug candidate SGT-210 under investigation for the treatment of rare skin keratodermas. For additional information, please visit www.sol-gel.com . title: Accessibility in Modern Voting Systems – Our Letter to the EAC
body_text: Since January of this year, VotingWorks has been in testing with the Election Assistance Commission to the latest federal standard – the Voluntary Voting Systems Guidelines v2.0. In that process, vendors submit Requests for Information (RFIs) to the EAC to get clarification on areas of the standard that may be ambiguous. This is particularly common for a new standard like VVSG 2.0. Recently, the EAC has been considering an RFI regarding accessibility. This RFI was not submitted by VotingWorks, but it’s an RFI in which we take great interest. Effectively, the RFI asks whether a VVSG 2.0 voting system can include a Ballot Marking Device that supports only a small portion of the new accessibility requirements, as long as a different Ballot Marking Device within the complete system supports the other requirements. We think certifying these less-accessible Ballot-Marking Devices would break the spirit of VVSG 2.0, and, in practice, would greatly weaken the accessibility advances of VVSG 2.0. Two weeks ago, we sent a letter to the EAC to explain our position. As part of our commitment to transparency, we’re posting the full letter here .

title: Roteiro de SEO: Como Criar um + Modelo Gratuito
summary: Um documento de roteiro de SEO descreve as etapas para melhorar o desempenho do seu site nos mecanismos de busca. Aprenda como criar um.
body_text: Traduzimos este artigo do inglês. Clique aqui para ler o artigo original. Se você notar algum problema com o conteúdo, não hesite em entrar em contato conosco pelo e-mail report-osteam@semrush.com . O que é um roteiro de SEO? Um roteiro de SEO é um documento que formaliza um plano passo a passo para melhorar o desempenho do seu site nos mecanismos de busca. Completo com tarefas, cronogramas e responsáveis. É personalizado para atender aos seus objetivos específicos de SEO. E trabalhar para alcançá-los deve, em última análise, ajudá-lo a atingir seus objetivos comerciais gerais. Você pode criar um roteiro de SEO usando uma planilha do Google ou qualquer outra ferramenta de gerenciamento de projetos. Eis um exemplo de como isso poderia ser: Baixe nosso modelo de roteiro de SEO gratuito para acompanhar o restante deste guia. Por que você precisa de um roteiro de SEO Aqui estão algumas maneiras pelas quais um roteiro de SEO pode te ajudar: Simplifique tarefas complexas Um roteiro de SEO divide o processo de SEO em tarefas menores e mais gerenciáveis. Por exemplo, em vez de ter como objetivo geral "melhorar o SEO", o planejamento pode começar com uma pesquisa específica de palavras-chave. Em seguida, passe a otimizar páginas individuais. Priorize os esforços de alto impacto. Utilizar um roteiro ajuda você a se concentrar nas ações que trazem os maiores benefícios. Assim você não perde tempo com coisas que não terão impacto. Por exemplo, se a maior parte do seu tráfego orgânico vier de algumas páginas com melhor desempenho, seu planejamento estratégico pode priorizar a otimização desse conteúdo antes de criar novas páginas. Adapte-se às atualizações dos mecanismos de busca Seu roteiro é um documento vivo. Assim você pode ajustá-lo em resposta a mudanças no algoritmo do mecanismo de busca . Para garantir que seus esforços de SEO permaneçam eficazes ao longo do tempo. Por exemplo, se o Google começar a priorizar mais as métricas de experiência do usuário (UX) no futuro, seu planejamento estratégico poderá mudar para priorizar a melhoria da navegação com menus fáceis de usar em detrimento de tudo o mais. Como criar e usar um roteiro de SEO Criar e implementar um roteiro de SEO envolve muito planejamento prévio e colaboração. Eis como fazer: 1. Defina seus objetivos de SEO . E oferece uma maneira clara de medir o sucesso posteriormente. Comece por identificar o que deseja alcançar com seus esforços de SEO. Seja para aumentar o reconhecimento da marca, gerar leads ou qualquer outra coisa. Em seguida, defina metas específicas, mensuráveis, alcançáveis, relevantes e com prazo definido (SMART) para garantir que seus objetivos sejam claros e viáveis. Digamos que sua empresa queira aumentar as vendas online em 10% no próximo ano. Assim, você reforça isso definindo uma meta de SEO para aumentar o tráfego orgânico em 25% nos próximos nove meses. Qual você considera viável com base no seu orçamento e nas limitações de recursos? Seu principal indicador-chave de desempenho (KPI) é o tráfego orgânico. . Em seguida, estabeleça cronogramas claros para garantir que sua equipe permaneça no caminho certo e progrida consistentemente em direção às suas metas. Ao definir os prazos para suas tarefas, tenha em mente estas dicas: Para ser realista em suas estimativas de tempo, leve em consideração a carga de trabalho e outros compromissos dos membros da equipe. Adicione alguma flexibilidade aos seus prazos para acomodar desafios ou atrasos inesperados. Revise e ajuste seus cronogramas regularmente, conforme necessário, com base no progresso, em mudanças de prioridades ou em novas informações. 2. Analise seus KPIs de SEO Analisar seu desempenho atual com os KPIs que você estabeleceu pode ajudá-lo a entender o quanto você precisa melhorar para atingir seu objetivo. Vamos supor que seus KPIs sejam o posicionamento de palavras-chave e o tráfego orgânico. Você precisará obter medições de referência para cada uma dessas métricas. E talvez algumas informações complementares. Utilize o Google Analytics para monitorar o tráfego orgânico. Faça login na sua conta do GA e vá para a guia " Relatórios ". Em seguida, clique em “ Aquisição ” > “ Aquisição de tráfego .” Você verá todo o tráfego do período selecionado, discriminado por canal. Preste atenção à linha "Busca Orgânica", pois ela indica a quantidade de tráfego orgânico que seu site recebe. . Abra a ferramenta e crie um projeto, caso ainda não o tenha feito. Em seguida, insira seu domínio e clique em " Configurar rastreamento ." Conclua a configuração. Após a configuração, você verá um relatório "Paisagem". Esta ferramenta resume a visibilidade do seu domínio, o tráfego estimado e a posição média para as suas palavras-chave monitorizadas. Vá para a aba “ Visão geral ” e role para baixo até a seção “Visão geral das classificações”. Esta seção mostra a posição do seu site para palavras-chave individuais e como essas posições mudaram em relação ao período anterior. Compreender o seu posicionamento atual nas palavras-chave e o tráfego orgânico ajudará você a mensurar seu progresso ao longo do caminho. 3. Realizar uma auditoria técnica . E coisas que afetam a experiência do usuário (UX) — experiência do usuário em SEO refere-se à facilidade com que os visitantes podem navegar e interagir com seu site. Ter uma boa experiência do usuário (UX) é especialmente importante porque pode reduzir a taxa de rejeição e incentivar os visitantes a explorar mais páginas. E proporcionar uma experiência do usuário positiva pode impulsionar seu desempenho em SEO. . Encontre esses problemas usando a ferramenta Auditoria de Site do Semrush. Abra a ferramenta, insira seu domínio e clique em " Iniciar auditoria ." Você verá as "Configurações de auditoria do site". Conclua a configuração para configurar sua primeira verificação do site e clique em “ Iniciar auditoria do site ”. Após a conclusão da auditoria, você verá um relatório de "Visão Geral". A primeira coisa que você deve analisar é a pontuação de Saúde do Site. Esse valor é calculado com base no número de erros e avisos encontrados em seu site. Quanto maior esse número, melhor. Em seguida, vá para a guia " Problemas " para ver a lista de problemas em seu site. Você verá a mensagem “Erros”, que são os mais graves. Além dos "Avisos", também existem problemas de gravidade média. E “Avisos” — assuntos não críticos que vale a pena considerar. Para problemas individuais, clique em " Por que e como corrigir " para saber mais sobre o problema e como resolvê-lo. Anote os problemas aqui para que você possa priorizar quais adicionar ao seu planejamento. 4. Descubra oportunidades de otimização na página SEO On-page ajuda os mecanismos de busca a entenderem o conteúdo das suas páginas, aumentando as chances de obter uma classificação mais alta nos resultados de pesquisa para palavras-chave relevantes. Alguns elementos-chave na página incluem títulos de página (também chamados de H1s), cabeçalhos, meta descrições (HTML que resume brevemente uma página) e estrutura de URL. . Abra a ferramenta, insira seu domínio e clique em " Obter ideias ." Conclua a configuração. Assim que a ferramenta estiver pronta, você verá um relatório de "Visão geral" como este: Vá para a aba “ Ideias de Otimização ”. Você encontrará ideias específicas para cada página relacionadas a estratégia, conteúdo, backlinks, semântica, experiência do usuário, etc. Clique em “ # ideias ” ao lado de uma das páginas para ver as recomendações para melhorar o SEO da página. Em seguida, você poderá ver as ideias agrupadas nas categorias “Estratégia” e “Conteúdo”. Por exemplo, a seção de conteúdo indicará se você precisa incorporar suas palavras-chave alvo no título H1, no corpo da página e em outras áreas importantes. Analise as ideias. Você adicionará os mais importantes ao seu planejamento mais tarde. A ideia é tornar cada página relevante e valiosa para o seu público. Assim, é mais provável que seja bem classificado pelos mecanismos de busca. Leitura adicional : Checklist de SEO On-Page: A Lista Completa de Tarefas para 2024 5. Analise seu perfil de backlinks. . Portanto, é uma boa ideia saber qual é a sua situação atual. Analise seu perfil de backlinks atual usando Análise de backlinks . A ferramenta mostra o número de backlinks que apontam para o seu site. E informações adicionais. Abra a ferramenta, insira seu domínio e clique em “ Analisar .” No relatório "Visão geral", você pode ver sua "Pontuação de autoridade", que é uma medida da saúde geral do seu site em uma escala de 100. E sua “Pontuação Geral de Toxicidade” — uma avaliação de quantos backlinks de baixa qualidade apontam para o seu site. É uma boa ideia considerar essas duas métricas em conjunto. Se sua pontuação de autoridade for baixa e sua pontuação de toxicidade for alta, isso indica que você deve trabalhar para obter mais links de sites relevantes e de alta qualidade. Em seguida, vá para a guia " Backlinks " para uma visualização detalhada de backlinks individuais. . E remova-os ou negue-os. Com essa ferramenta, você também pode comparar o perfil de backlinks do seu site com o dos seus concorrentes. Adicione os domínios dos seus concorrentes e você verá um relatório comparativo. Se você perceber que seus concorrentes têm mais backlinks de alta qualidade provenientes de sites relevantes em seu setor, você pode considerar entrar em contato com esses sites para obter backlinks. Anote os próximos passos apropriados para que você possa determinar como proceder ao começar a elaborar seu plano de ação de SEO. Leitura adicional : Como fazer uma auditoria de backlinks (5 passos simples) 6. Identificar novas oportunidades de conteúdo Identificar qual conteúdo tem melhor desempenho fornece informações sobre o que seus visitantes apreciam. Assim, você poderá replicar esse sucesso no futuro. Para revisar seu conteúdo existente, faça login no Google Analytics . Acesse “ Relatórios ” > " Engajamento " > " Páginas e telas .” E role a página para baixo para ver a lista de páginas com visualizações, usuários, tempo médio de engajamento e outros dados. Analise esses dados para entender quais tópicos repercutem no seu público. Por exemplo, se você perceber que seus guias detalhados atraem consistentemente mais tráfego e engajamento do que posts de blog mais curtos, você pode se concentrar em criar conteúdo mais abrangente daqui para frente. Além disso, identifique lacunas de conteúdo — tópicos centrados em palavras-chave para as quais seus concorrentes estão ranqueando, mas você não. Use a ferramenta Keyword Gap para identificar esses tópicos. Abra a ferramenta, insira seu domínio e os domínios de seus concorrentes e clique em " Comparar ." Você verá uma lista de palavras-chave comuns para as quais todos os sites estão bem posicionados. Clique em “ Ausentes ” para ver as palavras-chave para as quais todos os seus concorrentes estão classificados, mas você não. Em seguida, clique em “ Fraco ” para ver as palavras-chave para as quais seu site está classificado abaixo de seus concorrentes. Descobrir essas lacunas de palavras-chave permite que você crie conteúdo sobre tópicos que atendam a necessidades ainda não exploradas do público. Agora, anote todas as palavras-chave que deseja segmentar e todo o conteúdo que deseja criar. Assim, você pode incorporá-los ao seu plano estratégico de SEO. Leitura complementar : Como encontrar & Analisar palavras-chave da concorrência 7. Liste todas as suas tarefas de SEO . Digamos que sua lista seja assim: Otimize os títulos das páginas, as meta descrições e as tags de cabeçalho. Melhorar a compatibilidade com dispositivos móveis Corrigir links quebrados e erros de rastreamento Abordar conteúdo duplicado Simplifique a arquitetura do seu site. Melhore sua estrutura de links internos. Otimizar imagens Melhore a estrutura dos títulos dentro do conteúdo. Implementar marcação de esquema Avaliar palavras-chave Finalizar lista de palavras-chave Calendário de conteúdo do plano Crie conteúdo novo direcionado a palavras-chave de alto valor. Atualize o conteúdo existente para melhorar a relevância e a qualidade. Crie backlinks de alta qualidade a partir de sites com autoridade. Rastreie menções não vinculadas para transformá-las em backlinks. . 8. Identificar áreas prioritárias para ação. Priorizar suas tarefas de SEO ajuda você a criar um plano de ação focado que maximiza seus resultados e mantém sua equipe alinhada aos objetivos mais importantes. Isso significa que nem todas as tarefas entrarão no seu planejamento final. Como você pode priorizar suas tarefas? Aqui estão alguns fatores a serem considerados: Alinhamento com seus objetivos de SEO Impacto potencial Esforço necessário para a implementação Dependência de outras tarefas ou recursos Uma abordagem eficaz é usar uma matriz de prioridades, onde você classifica cada tarefa com base em seu impacto e esforço. As tarefas que se enquadram no quadrante "Vitórias Rápidas" (alto impacto e baixo esforço) devem ser abordadas primeiro. Porque oferecem os benefícios mais significativos com o menor investimento. Os itens do quadrante "Grandes Apostas" (alto impacto, alto esforço) devem ser cuidadosamente planejados e executados. "Itens de preenchimento" (de baixo impacto e pouco esforço) podem ser usados para preencher lacunas no seu documento de planejamento de SEO, caso haja espaço disponível. Tarefas ingratas (de baixo impacto e alto esforço) devem ser descartadas ou reavaliadas posteriormente. Por exemplo, atualizar as tags de título das páginas principais pode ser uma "Vitória Rápida", enquanto uma arquitetura de site reformulada pode ser uma "Grande Aposta". . 9. Defina marcos para acompanhar o progresso. Os marcos são pontos de verificação importantes ao longo da sua jornada de SEO, que destacam o progresso em direção aos seus objetivos. Elas oferecem uma visão geral do seu progresso. Por exemplo, seus marcos podem incluir: Concluir as melhorias técnicas de SEO até o final do primeiro trimestre. Publicar 10 novas postagens de blog com palavras-chave relevantes até o final do segundo trimestre. Atualizar todo o conteúdo de melhor desempenho até o final do terceiro trimestre. E lembre-se de verificar periodicamente seu progresso. Recomendamos que faça isso mensalmente e anote na coluna correspondente da sua planilha. 10. Alocar recursos A alocação eficaz de recursos garante que você tenha as habilidades e ferramentas necessárias para executar seu plano. Comece avaliando os recursos necessários para cada tarefa em sua lista de prioridades. Isso pode incluir: Tempo da equipe interna (por exemplo, criadores de conteúdo, desenvolvedores e especialistas em SEO) Conhecimento especializado externo (por exemplo, freelancers, agências e consultores) Ferramentas (por exemplo, ferramentas de SEO, ferramentas de análise e um sistema de gerenciamento de conteúdo) Com base nessa avaliação, aloque seus recursos disponíveis primeiro para as tarefas de maior prioridade. Seja realista quanto ao que você pode alcançar com seus recursos atuais e considere se investimentos adicionais são necessários para atingir seus objetivos (e dentro do seu orçamento). Por fim, atribua membros específicos da equipe ou parceiros externos responsáveis pela execução e elaboração de relatórios de cada item. E anote isso na sua planilha. Isso garante que todos conheçam seu papel e contribuam para o sucesso geral da sua estratégia de SEO. 11. Colaborar com as partes interessadas A comunicação com as partes interessadas é fundamental para obter a aprovação do seu plano de SEO. E demonstrando seu sucesso posteriormente. Comece apresentando seu plano de ação às principais partes interessadas. Reúna o feedback deles e esclareça quaisquer dúvidas que possam ter. Mais importante ainda, esteja disposto a adaptar seu planejamento conforme necessário. As prioridades empresariais podem mudar, e a opinião das partes interessadas pode trazer perspectivas valiosas. Após iniciar a implementação do plano, comunique regularmente o progresso dos seus esforços de SEO às partes interessadas. E compartilhe como você está progredindo em relação aos seus KPIs. 12. Avalie os resultados e revise seu plano de ação. SEO é um processo contínuo, não um projeto pontual. Portanto, seu roteiro de SEO deve ser um documento vivo que evolui à medida que você progride e aprende. Normalmente, um plano de ação para SEO tem duração de seis a doze meses. Após concluir todas as tarefas do roteiro inicial, é hora de avaliar seus KPIs para verificar se você atingiu seus objetivos. Se você fez isso, crie um novo roteiro que se baseie no seu progresso e aborde os pontos que você não conseguiu concluir no primeiro. Por exemplo, se seu primeiro roteiro focou bastante em pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimizações técnicas, seu próximo roteiro pode priorizar a criação de conteúdo em torno dessas palavras-chave e a construção de backlinks de alta qualidade. Se você não alcançou seus objetivos, talvez precise criar um plano de ação para enfrentar novos desafios. Ou talvez você precise ajustar seus objetivos. Leitura complementar : Resultados de SEO: Como rastrear & Medir o desempenho de SEO Construa uma base sólida com um roteiro de SEO. Um roteiro de SEO eficaz utiliza dados para definir etapas e tarefas exatas. Utilize as ferramentas adequadas para obter esses dados. Comece por auditar o seu site e compreender melhor os seus pontos fortes e fracos em termos de SEO. Cadastre-se gratuitamente no Semrush para começar a usar a Auditoria de Site .

title: Introducing Rebolt
summary: Introducing Rebolt
body_text: Why does Rebolt exist? “Again?” That’s what I thought as I watched my father copy the same data, again and again, from an email into a spreadsheet. It wasn’t lack of skill. It was a lack of better options. The sad truth is, most companies still run like this. Smart people stuck doing repetitive tasks. Reading emails, filling out documents, checking the same things over and over. Work that shouldn’t be work. And when a company wants to automate, they face three scenarios: They surrender and don't do it, because it is expensive or slow Buy bloated, overpriced software that doesn’t really fit Hire engineers, if you can afford it What if you could have a great engineer, without hiring anyone? One that understands your company. That never sleeps. That gets it done. That’s Rebolt. We built Rebolt to eliminate the repetitive and give people room to do what matters. Why now? For the first time, thanks to Large Language Models (LLMs), the technology behind ChatGPT, computers can read, write, and reason like humans do. That changes everything. Join us We’re creating something that feels magical and delightful. And we want you to experience it too. Be the first to launch your company Try it here Are you obsessed with this problem? Work with us

title: Sourcebot v4 release
summary: Code navigation, required authentication, faster search results, and more.
body_text: Sourcebot v4 introduces code navigation, changes to authentication, search result performance improvements, and more! Code Navigation Sourcebot now lets you navigate across symbols in your code base with “go-to definition” and “find all references” support. This feature requires an enterprise license, feel free to reach out if you’d like a trial! Authentication Changes Beginning in v4, authentication will be required in Sourcebot. The first account to register onto a Sourcebot deployment will be the owner, and all new accounts that register must be approved by the owner. Credential and email code registration is supported in core, with SSO/OAuth providers supported in enterprise. Check out our auth docs for more info, and reach out if you’d like a trial license! Performance improvements We’ve overhauled how code results are rendered, which results in significant performance improvements when scrolling through a large amount of search results. Dynamic filter updates Filter by repository and language will now dynamically update, ensuring that the filter options accurately reflect the current filter state. Filter panel visibility shortcut You can now toggle the visibility of the filter panel with command+B Upgrading to v4 is super easy, check out our upgrade guide for more info. If you have any feedback on the release or want to suggest additional changes, please check out our discord or github discussions page.
